bugs_found: Malformed .banking-profile YAML or non-mapping content crashes contract-presence, contract-validate, floats-check, and all instead of returning configuration error code 2.
review-validate and review-gate accept literal branch fallback paths, allowing absolute paths or ../ traversal to validate/gate JSON outside .claude/reviews.
review-gate claims latest round overall must approve but never checks latest overall verdict, so a later math-auditor request-changes round can still pass if code-reviewer approved.

review-gate deduplicates findings by lexicographic filename order, not actual round number and agent protocol order, so round-10 is processed before round-2 and stale acks can silently override newer findings.
review-gate trusts any finding with matching id from any later file, so an adversarial later minor finding can overwrite an earlier blocker/major with the same id and hide an unresolved severe issue.
review-gate never validates manifest or round JSON against schemas before gating, so malformed review artifacts can pass if they contain the few fields inspected.

contract-presence only compares contract name to function name globally per file; one contract block can satisfy multiple functions with the same name in different scopes/classes and block placement is not tied to the function it documents.
contract-presence uses regex over raw Python text, so commented-out or string-literal def lines are treated as real functions and real decorated/multiline/edge-case definitions may be misclassified.
contract-validate silently ignores unreadable or invalid-encoding sensitive files, allowing contracts in inaccessible files to be skipped without a failure.
floats-check silently ignores unreadable or invalid-encoding sensitive files after counting them as checked, allowing money-path code to bypass scanning.

floats-check misses many precision-risk money floats such as numeric literals, JavaScript arithmetic on number-typed inferred values, Python variables assigned float literals, Decimal constructed from float, and TypeScript interfaces using optional/union forms not matched.

iter_files_under_sensitive does not protect against symlinks or path escape from repo_root, so sensitive glob traversal can scan arbitrary linked filesystem paths or crash on relative_to for escaped paths.
